notes: Access terms verified from official sources on verified_on. Re-check before acquiring. assistance_label is always UNKNOWN for the three public deception datasets.

michigan_deception.license_short: No license file in archive or on page; released by the authors for research. Cite Perez-Rosas et al. ICMI 2015.
michigan_deception.citation: Veronica Perez-Rosas, Mohamed Abouelenien, Rada Mihalcea, Mihai Burzo. Deception Detection using Real-life Trial Data. ICMI 2015.
michigan_deception.contents: 121 courtroom trial clips (61 deceptive, 60 truthful, ~260 MB uncompressed), per-clip transcripts (.txt), gesture annotation CSV.
michigan_deception.known_limitations: No speaker/participant IDs; clips from the same trial may share a speaker, so group-aware splitting needs manual speaker annotation.

dolos.license_short: ROSE Lab Release Agreement: academic, non-commercial research only; no redistribution or derived datasets without permission.
dolos.contents: Deception clips from a reality game show, with MUMIN behavior annotations.
manual_steps: Create a ROSE Lab account with your CMU email at https://rose1.ntu.edu.sg/
Open https://rose1.ntu.edu.sg/dataset/DOLOS/, click Request, and accept the Release Agreement
Wait for approval; download only via the channel ROSE Lab provides (do not use the GitHub YouTube downloader as a substitute for approval)

bag_of_lies.license_short: Signed license agreement required (research/educational, non-commercial). User_12 data must not appear in publications. Cite the paper.
bag_of_lies.approx_size_note: Reported as 6.14 GB on the official page.
bag_of_lies.contents: Multimodal (video, audio, EEG, gaze) deception recordings.
manual_steps: Have it signed by someone with legal authority for CMU (e.g. via your advisor and CMU Office of Sponsored Programs); student/faculty signatures alone are rejected
Email it to databases@iab-rubric.org with subject 'License agreement for Bag-of-Lies Database'

They reply with the password for the Google Drive download; the archive (6.14 GB) exceeds the 500 MB local limit, so transfer it Drive-to-Drive (e.g. 'Make a copy'/shortcut or a Colab notebook), not via the laptop

staged_interviews.license_short: Team-collected; governed by participant consent / IRB protocol. Never share outside the team.
staged_interviews.contents: Controlled answers labeled HUMAN_UNASSISTED / AI_ASSISTED / AI_VERBATIM / AI_PERSONALIZED.
manual_steps: Record under the approved protocol; upload directly to Drive; add rows to manifests/files/staged_interviews.csv
